title: Jude and the Room
author: Orsen Ravensworth
blurb: Ivo Okonkwo, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
